title: How Watts gave up drinking when he married
summary: Watts tells how his future wife, a church worker, told him that either she or the whiskey must go, and he quit sixteen years earlier.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
